title: Independent review of LR-002 (validation-only lr/epoch extension incl. linear head)
description: User approved LR-002 (2026-11-26); review follows the submit-then-independent-review protocol. Check pre-registration timing (ledger add vs first run in grid_log.txt), that no test data was evaluated, that analyze.py implements task.json exactly (candidate set incl. LR-001 3e-4@10 for dictionary heads, 10-epoch budget read from 20-epoch histories by top-1 then lower CE, baselines, switch rule >=0.30 pp and >=5/6, edge/budget flags, instability, 24 sanity reproductions vs LR-001 and GRID-002), the validity of the 'first 10 epochs of a 20-epoch run equal a 10-epoch run' premise (constant lr, per-epoch reseeding; the sanity cells test it), the linear-head wrapper in src/run_lrcheck2.py (it temporarily overrides run_grid.LR/EPOCHS), recompute the decision table and exploratory gaps from the 78 runs/LR-002 done.json histories (and LR-001 lr3e-4 histories), and check overclaiming: validation-only, repeated selection on seeds 42-44, grid holes, un-retuned k/weight decay, unequal epoch budgets, the post-hoc exploratory rows, and the strength of the implications drawn for GRID-002/SEED-001/MSWEEP-001. Read-only outside this folder; no training. Record a verdict.
acceptance: Verdict on LR-002 recorded with a note citing this report or the checks done
Decision table and key exploratory gaps independently recomputed
Pre-registration timing, validation-only claim and the 10-of-20-epochs premise verified
